reconcile.note: Henry ties Exodus 4:11's claim of divine authorship over disability to John 9:3, treating both as expressions of the same providential purpose.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the shift in agency, since Exodus names God as the maker of blindness and deafness while Mark blames a spirit Jesus expels.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.verseText: Yahweh said to him, \"Who made man's mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn't it I, Yahweh?

sides.snippet: You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him
sides.verseText: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, \"You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!\"
